name: Modern Wine Shop
tagline: A bright, fun storefront for a modern wine club and bottle shop.
description: A complete, working shop for a bright, modern wine club and bottle shop: a real catalogue of approachable bottles — a house red, a bold dinner red, a crisp white, a rosé, a pét-nat, a non-alc fizz, a flexible wine club, a mixed six and a gift set — with categories, collections, a bespoke bottle-shop PDP and a fully merchandised home page. Bright pale-blush theme — a punchy berry primary, a coral accent and a modern display face. Shipped as Coupe.

media.alt: Modern Wine Shop — home page preview
